name: Aevral
tagline: Install the Aevral GitHub App for pull request security review
description: Setup skill that walks you through installing the Aevral GitHub App so pull requests get a security review: access control, business logic, injection, XSS, SSRF, path traversal, unsafe deserialization, token and session flaws, and LLM-integration risks, with a suggested fix you apply. Reviews run server-side; this skill does not review code locally. Public repos are free.
